description_en: Configures the advertising of a CIDR block
kebab_example: aliyun ddosdiversion config-net-status --sale-id ddos_diversion_public_cn-xxxxxxxxxxxxx --net 192.168.XX.XX/22 --status enable --region cn-hangzhou
name: ConfigNetStatus

parameters.help_en: The ID of the anti-DDoS diversion instance
parameters.name: sale_id

parameters.help_en: The CIDR block of the anti-DDoS diversion instance
parameters.name: net

parameters.help_en:
The status of the CIDR block. Valid values:

enable: advertises the CIDR block.

disable: withdraws the advertising of the CIDR block
parameters.help_zh:
状态。取值：

enable：宣告。
disable：撤销
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The regions in which the CIDR block needs to be advertised or withdrawn from advertising. If you leave this parameter empty, the CIDR blocks in all regions are configured.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2639086.html operation to obtain the regions of the CIDR blocks
parameters.help_zh:
网段需要宣告/撤销的区域列表，当列表为空时，表示操作所有网段配置的区域。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2639086.html获取网段配置的区域信息
parameters.name: regions

parameters.help_en: The subnet CIDR blocks of the CIDR block
parameters.help_zh: 代播实例网段的子网段列表
parameters.name: sub_nets

Code.description_en:
The status code.

200: The request was successful.

Other codes: The request failed
Code.description_zh:
接口返回码：

200：表示成功。
其它：表示错误码

RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
